concept: A field is a groove cut into the glass and read by its two lips, with shade under the top one and light along the bottom one. It is a full pill because it is held.

default_to_avoid.pattern: the borderless grey filled text field or search bar (Material filled text field, iOS search bar, a pale well with a faint ring) as the input
default_to_avoid.why_not: on a white surface the grey fill disappears; the shipped well measured 1.3:1 in the light theme and the search field vanished on a white page (R-009)

derivation.consequence: legibility comes from dimming and blurring the backdrop (brightness, blur) inside a smoked body thick enough that a pane reads as a slab of glass, with the scene softened behind it
derivation.form: the field is a groove whose floor is the surface dimmed and whose edge is shade under the top lip

derivation.consequence: the rim and sheen are white at low opacity, like light catching an edge
derivation.form: the bottom lip catches light, a white line that carries the 3:1 edge on dark glass

derivation.consequence: opaque pairs are computed, glass pairs are measured
derivation.form: the edge is measured on every surface in both themes (G-NT2), and the light theme adds an ink ring because white light on white measures nothing

derivation.consequence: controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: single-line fields stay full pills; the textarea keeps nested corners because it grows

variants.supersedes: A well in the pane (forms round, 2026-10-27)
variants.reason: B is D-020's well made legible: the lit bottom lip is the light catching an edge that P3 asks for, and the edge measured 3.0 to 3.1:1 in the lab, raised to a wider margin in the tokens. A passes too but is a ring around a box, closer to the default. C is the outlined field every kit ships and drops the well (D-020).

md.why: the default height is 44px, the touch size every target in Pane must reach

root.why: the component owns the spacing between its own parts, so children never carry margins and rows line up

sm.why: the small size is 32px for dense desktop toolbars and stays below the touch size, which the docs say plainly

wrap.why: a field with a clear button or a count stacks the field and its count

idle.why: the clear button keeps its place while the field is empty so typing never widens the field

glyph.why: the cross is drawn with the ring stroke in the secondary tone, quieter than the text

count.why: the count is caption size in tabular figures at the end, under the field

full.why: at the limit the count comes up to the primary tone and medium weight

sr.why: near the limit the count is said in words, and not at every key

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the well becomes a system-colour border, so the field keeps its edge without glass

aria-invalid=true.why: an invalid field draws a 2px ring in the critical mark colour, and the error text says why

data-pane-card=glass.why: on a glass card the control is a dimmed well with an inner shadow; elsewhere it is the opaque page surface (P7)

disabled.why: disabled fades to the disabled opacity token and the reason is written beside it

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared 2px ring with its halo, visible on any part of any scene

hover.why: hover strengthens the ring a little, an answer to the pointer that moves nothing

box-shadow.why: the ring eases at hover pace so the change reads as an answer, never a flicker
